title.zh: 环境公共卫生（出庭通知）条例
title.en: Environmental Public Health (Notice to Attend Court) Regulations

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the Environmental Public Health (Notice to Attend Court) Regulations.

2. A Notice to be served on any person under section 21 of the Act shall be in Form A, B or C provided at the Agency’s official website at http://www.nea.gov.sg.
[S 129/2009 wef 01/04/2009]
[S 92/2017 wef 28/04/2017]
[S 279/2019 wef 01/04/2019]
